noah (growth): Hey team — for the benchmark launch next week I need a compact ‘stacked tiles’ interactive graphic set for blog + webinar + socials. @sam can you own design? sam (design): Yep. Quick q's — sizes, interactions (hover states / toggles?), and do we need animated versions for hero and social? :thinking_face: maria (mktg): Need: hero hero (1200x800), blog inline (800x400), social square (1080x1080), and a small banner (600x200). Interactions: toggle between latency-first / cost-first views, and a simple hover reveal for the 3 metrics. GIF for social + MP4 for short promo. sam (design): cool. Plan: Figma component with variants (layout + color scheme + accessibility states). Deliverables: SVG, 2 PNG sizes, animated GIF (loop ~3s), short MP4, and a Lottie for embed where possible. Also export tokenized pieces (tiles as separate svgs). sam (design): export naming convention — will use this pattern so ops can script CDN uploads: ``` export naming: bench_tiles/{variant}/{size}/{state}.{ext} examples: bench_tiles/core/1200x800/hero.png bench_tiles/cost-priority/1080x1080/social.gif bench_tiles/stacked/600x200/banner.svg ``` jules (legal): Heads-up — avoid absolute language like "cheapest" or "fastest" without attribution. If any percentile/claims are used include source line and test date. Also need accessible alt-text strings for each asset. maria (mktg): Noted. We'll prepare copy options: one explicit-callout (with data footnote), one soft-claim (no numbers), and a short tagline for social CTAs. ben (product): For the interactive embed on docs/webinar page, can you include a tiny HTML snippet that toggles variants? I can wire telemetry for clicks. Something like: ```
``` luna (devex): If you're planning CDN hosting, pls add hashed filenames and a small script for responsive srcset. Also optimize the GIFs (webp where supported). I can add a small pipeline step in our assets repo. sam (design): Will do. Questions for legal @jules — do you want a mandatory claims footer baked into the assets or an optional overlay we can toggle in Figma? jules (legal): Optional overlay is fine as long as every public asset has a linked footnote in the copy. For slides/webinar please include a one-slide appendix with test methodology. maria (mktg): Timeline: can we get initial comps by Wednesday EOD, revisions Thursday, final assets Friday morning? Also need 2 short hero cutdowns for webinar (30s / 15s). noah (growth): That timeline works for launch schedule. Also please include a pack of social captions (short + alt variations). sam (design): I'll prototype the Figma file and drop a link here when ready. Will include: color tokens (WCAG pass), component states, export scripts, and an export checklist. luna (devex): FYI I'll create a PR template so ops knows how to upload with correct metadata (claim tags, test date, alt text). jules (legal): Quick checklist for asset compliance: 1) claim language + source 2) alt text 3) date of test 4) contact owner. If all present, legal sign-off is fast. maria (mktg): Perfect. Sam — please flag any tradeoffs on animation vs file size in the first drop. sam (design): Will do — aiming for small file sizes first, progressive enhancement for Lottie/MP4. Dropping first Figma link by Wed 10am. noah (growth): Thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @sam (accept design), @jules (confirm compliance once comps up), @luna (prepare upload pipeline). :rocket:
